name: UV tanning bed

lead: A UV tanning bed is a device with lamps that emit mostly UVA, with some UVB, to darken the skin. Commercial salons and home units exist.
It produces a tan quickly, but the International Agency for Research on Cancer classifies UV-emitting tanning devices as carcinogenic to humans.

paras: UV radiation damages skin cell DNA, which triggers melanin production and darkening; the tan is a response to that injury. The same DNA damage is linked to photoaging and skin cancer.

Meta-analyses link indoor tanning to melanoma, with pooled relative risks of roughly 1.2 to 1.3, higher with early-age and frequent use, and to non-melanoma skin cancer. One 2013 analysis disputed the strength of the association in higher-quality studies. Tanning accelerates wrinkles and sunburn is common; claims of safe or healthy tanning are not supported by the evidence.
